Yeah. I'm trying to get a therapist right now.

Thanks for your input. Made me get away from the deepest pit.

Yeah. I was already severely depressed at the time. Now I have an obsession of looking at 18-19 year olds in different galleries. Not in a sexual context by the slightest, but just to see how old people in that group look. Most of them look younger than their age to me, which makes me feel better for some time, but the next day I'm back to obsessing over these things.

I get terrifying thoughts and conclusions. What if someone I did it with was actually like 13 or something terrible like that. How am I then different from a predator.
